title: Provisioning failure message template + channel routing (runbook/logs/Linear links)
author: Allison Grant
body:
Context: As part of the provision-to-ready automation sprint, we need actionable, consistent notifications when a provisioning run fails (or is stuck) so Infra/SRE can respond quickly and avoid noisy handoffs. This PR adds a new Slack message template for provisioning failures and updates channel routing rules so the right teams get the right signal (paging vs non-paging). The template includes direct links to the relevant runbook, logs, metrics dashboard, and the associated Linear issue (or a prefilled create-issue link). This also addresses INT-1046 by adding a deterministic dedupe key for failure updates to avoid duplicate posts when retries occur.

What changed (high level): Added a ProvisioningFailureV1 template with standardized fields (pool_id, region, sku, stage, error_category, run_id/correlation_id, retry_count, created_at, owner/team) and a compact summary block for quick scanning in channel. Added link builders for: (1) Confluence runbook (dedicated pool provisioning runbook), (2) Grafana dashboard filtered by pool/run_id, (3) Loki logs query filtered by correlation_id/pool_id, and (4) Linear issue deep link (existing issue if present; otherwise a prefilled issue form with context). Updated routing rules to send messages to #eng-infra by default; additionally send to #eng-sre for error_category in {NETWORKING, DNS_TLS, CONTROL_PLANE_READY, PERF_CANARY} or when retries exceed threshold; optionally page on-call via PagerDuty integration only for hard-fail categories and production pools.

Routing behavior (new): Default channel: #eng-infra. Secondary channel (non-paging): #eng-sre when severity>=SEV2 or stage in {Bootstrapping, Validating} with production env. Paging: only when env=prod AND (error_category in {QUOTA_BLOCKED, GPU_HEALTH_CRITICAL, CONTROL_PLANE_STUCK_READY} OR stage_duration_minutes > hard_deadline). Noise controls: (a) dedupe_key = sha1(pool_id + run_id + stage + error_category) with a 30m TTL; (b) retries post as message update (thread reply) rather than new top-level message; (c) maximum 1 pager event per run_id unless the category changes.

Message content (example): Title line: "Provisioning failed: pool=dedicated-acme-prod-usw2-a100 stage=Bootstrapping category=HELM_VALUES_INVALID". Fields: Run ID, Correlation ID, Region/SKU, First seen, Retries, Owner. Links: "Runbook", "Logs (Loki)", "Dashboard (Grafana)", "Control plane run status", "Linear issue". Footer: "Break-glass note: if validation is blocked by policy gate and this is an approved edge case, see ADR-0143 and use audited override." (Note: no secrets included).

Implementation notes: Link builders use configured base URLs (GRAFANA_BASE_URL, LOKI_BASE_URL, CONFLUENCE_BASE_URL, CONTROL_PLANE_BASE_URL, LINEAR_TEAM_ID). All user-provided strings are escaped for Slack mrkdwn and truncated to avoid exceeding block limits. Added unit tests for routing matrix and link formatting.

Rollout: This ships behind the existing provisioning notification toggle (NOTIFY_PROVISIONING_EVENTS). Once merged, SRE will enable for staging first, then prod after verifying dedupe and routing behavior.

Screenshots/logs: Included in unit test fixtures and a sample payload in docs. No customer data.

Follow-ups (not in this PR): Add a separate template for "stuck stage" warnings (pre-fail) and integrate with the new time-to-ready alerts once thresholds are finalized.

incident-bot: add link builder helpers for runbook/grafana/loki/linear

conversation: Vanessa Ortiz: Can we make sure the message includes pool_id + correlation_id prominently? Those are what operators ask for first.
Allison Grant (author): Done — added both as top-level fields and in the title line (pool_id) plus a dedicated "Correlation ID" field for copy/paste into logs.

Rafael Mendes: Routing looks good, but I’d prefer we don’t page on QUOTA_BLOCKED by default; it’s usually an infra ticket rather than a wake-up. Can we make that non-paging unless it blocks a prod expansion past 60m?

Allison Grant (author): Updated: QUOTA_BLOCKED no longer pages by default. It routes to #eng-infra + creates a ticket link; paging only triggers if stage_duration_minutes > hard_deadline AND env=prod.
Connor O'Brien: Please add noise control for retries so we don’t get a new top-level message every backoff attempt. Thread updates are fine.

Allison Grant (author): Implemented dedupe_key + TTL and changed retry events to post as thread replies (or message updates when we have ts). Added tests for at-most-one top-level post per (pool_id, run_id, stage, category).
Sergio Costa: Link formatting: can we include default Grafana time range (last 6h) and template vars for pool/run_id? Also ensure URL encoding for correlation_id.
Allison Grant (author): Added from=now-6h&to=now and URL encoding for queries. Tests updated with fixtures.
Rafael Mendes: One more ask: ensure we do not include raw helm values or any secrets in error details. Truncate and sanitize.
Allison Grant (author): Added sanitization + truncation (1.5k chars) and redaction patterns for common secret keys. Documented in template docs.
release_notes: Incident-bot now posts provisioning failure notifications with direct links to runbooks/logs/dashboards and improved channel routing + retry dedupe to reduce noise.
